info.name: SumOffice Office
info.summary: Excel and Word files keep working — macros, Power Query, files back intact — with the SumOffice editors as your Office server
info.description:
Connects Nextcloud Office to a **SumOffice** server — SumSheet for .xlsx / .xlsm / .xlsb and SumDoc for .docx — with one field: the address of your SumOffice stack.
What you get:
* **Your Excel files keep working.** A workbook with macros and Power Query opens from Files, is edited in the browser, and comes back with its VBA project byte for byte; Excel opens it clean. * **Word documents the same way**, pictures and charts intact. * **Nothing leaves your servers**: the editors run in your own Docker (`hissih/sumsheet-webhost`, `hissih/sumdoc-webhost`), Nextcloud stays the WOPI host.
This app is the installer: it points the standard Nextcloud Office (richdocuments) app at your SumOffice server, checks the discovery and capabilities endpoints, and shows what the server offers. It requires Nextcloud Office to be installed.
Three steps, measured on a real macro workbook: https://sumoffice.com/nextcloud
